title: Scaffold
body: The company exists, under the old codename. The repo holds a Cargo workspace with stub crates for the engine, a headless CLI runner, and Tank Arena; CI (fmt, clippy, tests, a 10-match headless smoke run, and a wasm build check); a nightly workflow skeleton; this placeholder site; and the company's charter, state file, decision records and role briefs.
next: the Engine Lead builds the deterministic 60 Hz sim core while the Tank Designer-Developer writes the Tank Arena spec for Nye's approval.
